notes:
Refers specifically to gestures made with the hands, often to emphasize speech or communicate without words. Frequently paired with ⟦{身振|みぶ}り→身振り：14786_miburi⟧ (body gesture) in the set phrase {手振|てぶ}り⟦{身振|みぶ}り→身振り：14786_miburi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手振|てぶ}り⟦{身振|みぶ}り→身振り：14786_miburi⟧: gestures and body language
- {手振|てぶ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|まじ}える: to mix in hand gestures
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{手振|てぶ}り: large/exaggerated gestures
- {手振|てぶ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to indicate with a hand gesture

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{身振|みぶ}り→身振り：14786_miburi⟧: body gesture (broader — includes movement of the whole body)
- ⟦ジェスチャー→ジェスチャー：25679_jesuchaa⟧: gesture (loanword, used broadly in casual speech)
- ⟦{合図|あいず}→合図：01675_aizu⟧: signal (a deliberate, agreed-upon sign rather than spontaneous movement)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese communication tends to use fewer hand gestures than many Western cultures. However, certain gestures are distinctly Japanese, such as waving the hand in front of the face to indicate "no" or pointing to one's own nose to mean "me."
